meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地大模型并管理模型库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中运行本地大模型并管理模型库
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local models and manage model library
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run local LLMs in containers and manage model libraries

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可通过 Ollama MCP 服务器调用本地模型：列出已安装模型、向指定模型发送提示词获取回复；若启用管理工具，还能拉取、删除、查看模型信息及列出运行中的模型。
howto.when: 当用户要求使用 Ollama 本地模型进行推理、列出模型，或管理模型库（如拉取、删除）时触发。

say.text: 用 Ollama 告诉我法国的首都
say.note: Claude 会列出可用模型，再调用生成工具回答。
Claude 会调用拉取模型工具下载并安装该模型。

say.text: 当前有哪些 Ollama 模型在运行？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the Ollama MCP server to call local models: list installed models, send prompts to a specified model and get replies; if admin tools are enabled, it can also pull, delete, show model info, and list running models.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to use Ollama local models for inference, list models, or manage the model library (e.g., pull, delete).

say_en.text: Use Ollama to tell me the capital of France.
say_en.note: Claude lists models and uses the generate tool to answer.
Claude calls the pull model tool to download and install it.

say_en.text: Which Ollama models are currently running?
say_en.note: Claude calls ollama_list_running to check models in memory.
